vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: quotas and usage
vision.paraphrase: Spend is charged at the real cost OpenRouter reports for each clip, not an estimate.

conops.paraphrase: On each miss the gateway reads the real cost of the clip and records a usage row.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: quotas and usage
vision.paraphrase: If the reported cost cannot be read, the clip is charged from the configured model price, so spend is never left unrecorded.

conops.paraphrase: The cost constraint says that when real cost cannot be read, the clip is charged from the configured price and a warning is logged.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: Clips already made stay cached and charged when a later clip fails, so the caller pays only for audio they received.

conops.paraphrase: Clips synthesized before a failure are cached and charged to the caller.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: quotas and usage
vision.paraphrase: Every caller without an override gets the default monthly quota of $25 from configuration.

conops.paraphrase: The usage and quota table gives every user a monthly USD quota with a $25 default on a UTC calendar month.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: quotas and usage
vision.paraphrase: A call that starts under quota runs to completion, and the result notes when the caller is now over quota.

conops.paraphrase: A call that starts under the quota completes, and the result notes the caller is now over their monthly quota.
The quota timing assumption checks the quota at call start and lets a call finish even if it ends over.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: quotas and usage
vision.paraphrase: Once spend reaches the quota, later calls are refused until the next UTC month, with an ERROR naming spend, quota and reset.

conops.paraphrase: The gateway refuses the next call before any synthesis and names the spend, quota and reset time.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: quotas and usage
vision.paraphrase: Reaching the quota exactly counts as reached, so the refusal applies at equality as well as above it.

conops.paraphrase: The refusal applies once spend is at or above the quota, not only once it passes it.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: quotas and usage
vision.paraphrase: The quota check applies per call, so an over-quota caller is refused even when every clip is already cached.

conops.paraphrase: A call whose clips are all cache hits is refused the same way because the quota gate is per call.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: quotas and usage
vision.paraphrase: Spend is counted per calendar month in UTC, so the quota resets at 00:00 UTC on the first.

conops.paraphrase: The usage and quota table defines the quota period as the UTC calendar month.

vision.paraphrase: Goal G8 requires an admin's quota change to apply to that user's next call.

conops.paraphrase: After an admin raises a user's quota, that user's next synthesis call proceeds.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: quotas and usage
vision.paraphrase: my_usage reports month, spend, quota, remaining, clips, cache hits and reset date, so each caller knows where they stand.

conops.paraphrase: The user calls my_usage and sees the month, spend, quota, clip and cache-hit counts and the reset time.

vision.paraphrase: Money is shown in US dollars to the cent, so remaining amounts are quota minus spend at cent precision.

conops.paraphrase: My usage shows the remaining amount alongside spend and quota.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: quotas and usage
vision.paraphrase: Being over quota must not hide the caller's own usage, so my_usage still answers for an over-quota caller.

conops.paraphrase: An over-quota user can still call my_usage to see their figures.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Gateway: quotas and usage
vision.paraphrase: Usage rows hold counts and the cache key only, and narration text is never stored or logged.

conops.paraphrase: The privacy constraint says narration text is never stored or logged and usage rows hold only counts and keys.
